category: 微分方程 / 常微分方程
literal_source_claim_en: A numerical method for stiff equations.
source_attribution: Many mathematicians, twentieth century (catalog metadata only; not a source citation)
statement_blocker: The repository supplies a method name and a broad stiff-equation gloss, not a proposition. It does not fix an order, coefficients or normalization, history indexing, time grid, constant or variable steps, state space, ODE class, starting data, regularity, stability or convergence notion, ordered binders, hypotheses, or conclusion. Selecting BDF1, BDF2, a recurrence convention, or a stability theorem would invent or substitute missing mathematics.
target_decision: redirect the catalog method label to a corrected, source-selected exact BDF proposition before ordinary statement or proof execution
domain_and_universes: Open: an exact source must fix scalar or normed state spaces and universes, scalar field, autonomous or nonautonomous vector field, time domain and grid, step policy, history representation, and all typeclass data.
conclusion: Open: the repository does not choose a recurrence identity, interpolation construction, coefficient theorem, consistency or order result, zero-stability or convergence result, stability theorem, implicit-step solvability theorem, or conjunction.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded at intake because no proposition is selected; the statement phase must resolve every boundary case listed in scope-map.md.
candidate_scope_not_credited: a source-normalized constant-step k-step BDF implicit recurrence
the derivative-at-the-newest-node construction from a Lagrange interpolant through recent solution values
the BDF1/backward-Euler or BDF2 special case
a consistency, local-truncation-error, order, zero-stability, convergence, A-stability, or stability-region theorem for source-selected orders
a variable-step BDF algorithm with step-ratio conditions or an existence and uniqueness theorem for its implicit update
degenerate_cases_to_resolve: order zero, order one, and unsupported orders
empty history, insufficient or inconsistent starting values, and recurrence start index
zero, negative, repeated, nonmonotone, or variable time steps and extreme step ratios
coincident interpolation nodes and singular leading coefficients
constant or zero vector fields and exact solutions of insufficient regularity
nonexistent or nonunique implicit updates and nonlinear-solver error
finite versus infinite horizon and scalar versus vector or Banach-space state
truncation, rounding, and starting-error treatment in the selected conclusion
excluded_substitutions: backward Euler or BDF2 presented as an unidentified all-order BDF theorem
a backward finite-difference derivative identity presented as an ODE method theorem
a generic implicit linear-multistep theorem without a checked source-to-BDF transport
a numerical experiment, stability plot, benchmark, or solver output
a recurrence, convergence, or stability property assumed as a structure field
generic derivative, interpolation, ODE, or existence APIs alone
the untrusted catalog label 已验证 used as source or proof evidence
